snippet.title: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The heist went wrong. Now there’s money everywhere.
Wishlist Cash & Stash on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/5182680/

Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story launches on Steam on December 10, 2026.

You’re the Vaultkeeper, and you’ve got over 16,000 scattered items to put away. Sort cash, gold, and silver, look for rare banknotes, and unlock tools to make the job easier. Read client dossiers to figure out what belongs in each safe-deposit box and what its owner was saving for.

Play the free demo → https://store.steampowered.com/app/5395490/
Come say hi on Discord → https://discord.gg/VqNzJb922J
Follow us on Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/cash_stash_game/

See you in the vault!
Castaways Games
